title.en: Ready mixed concrete sets the section order for concrete pump split piston φ280
title.zh: 预拌混凝土决定这篇混凝土泵分体活塞 φ280的章节顺序

description.en: Ready mixed concrete is only the order of the sections. The cells under those headings stay the cells already printed. Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists a split piston set at φ280 in rubber only. The page does not name a pump model or a service life for this outer diameter.
description.zh: 预拌混凝土只决定章节顺序。标题下面的格子仍是已经印出的格子。河北品锦机械把分体活塞套件列为 φ280，材料是只有橡胶。这一外径没有点名泵型号，也没有寿命。

h1.en: WHAT is Ready Mixed Concrete: concrete pump split piston φ280
h1.zh: 什么是预拌混凝土：混凝土泵分体活塞 φ280

directAnswer.en: Ready mixed concrete is only the order of the sections. The cells under those headings stay the cells already printed. A φ280 split piston is one outer-diameter row on the Xingtai split-piston page. It is sold as a set. The materials printed for this row are rubber only. No published pump page assigns φ280 to a model.
directAnswer.zh: 预拌混凝土只决定章节顺序。标题下面的格子仍是已经印出的格子。φ280 分体活塞是邢台分体活塞页上的一条外径。按套供货。这一行印出的材料是只有橡胶。没有任何已公布泵页把 φ280 指定到某一型号。

body.en: Under the source heading “WHAT is Ready Mixed Concrete”, the wording that follows is the printed catalogue fragment. The split piston is a replacement set for S-valve concrete pumps, supplied from Xingtai by Hebei Pinjin Machinery. The full outer-diameter list is φ150, φ180, φ195, φ200, φ220, φ230, φ250, φ260 and φ280. This note is only the φ280 row, materials: rubber only. Unit: set. The page does not print a compound grade, a hardness, or a service life.
body.zh: 在来源标题“什么是预拌混凝土”下面，接着写的是已经印出的目录片段。分体活塞是河北品锦机械从邢台供应的 S 阀混凝土泵替换套件。全部外径是 φ150, φ180, φ195, φ200, φ220, φ230, φ250, φ260 and φ280。本文只写 φ280 这一行，材料：只有橡胶。单位：套。页面没有印胶料牌号、硬度或寿命。

heading.zh: 为什么使用预拌混凝土

body.en: Under the source heading “WHY Use Ready Mixed Concrete”, the wording that follows is the printed catalogue fragment. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. The integral-piston page is a different part. Where the same φ280 also appears there, it is still not a pump-model assignment. Electric 20's 80 mm figure is a pipe inner diameter, not a piston outer diameter.
body.zh: 在来源标题“为什么使用预拌混凝土”下面，接着写的是已经印出的目录片段。这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 整体活塞是另一件配件。若同一个 φ280 也出现在那边，仍然不是泵型号的指定。电动20的 80 mm 是输送管内径，不是活塞外径。

heading.en: HOW to Order Ready Mixed Concrete

body.en: Under the source heading “HOW to Order Ready Mixed Concrete”, the wording that follows is the printed catalogue fragment. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Write split piston, φ280, the material row (rubber only), and the quantity in sets. Leave life and pump model blank if the machine check is not done.
body.zh: 在来源标题“如何订购预拌混凝土”下面，接着写的是已经印出的目录片段。邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 写明分体活塞、φ280、材料行（只有橡胶）和套数。若还没在机器上核对，寿命和泵型号留空。

body.en: Under the source heading “WHAT are the Responsibilities”, the wording that follows is the printed catalogue fragment. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Write split piston, φ280, the material row (rubber only), and the quantity in sets. Leave life and pump model blank if the machine check is not done. Image from the source page: https://www.nrmca.org/wp-content/uploads/2021/01/31pr.pdf
body.zh: 在来源标题“各方责任是什么”下面，接着写的是已经印出的目录片段。邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 写明分体活塞、φ280、材料行（只有橡胶）和套数。若还没在机器上核对，寿命和泵型号留空。 图来自来源页：https://www.nrmca.org/wp-content/uploads/2021/01/31pr.pdf

question.en: What stays printed for concrete pump split piston φ280 when the section heading is “WHAT is Ready Mixed Concrete”?
question.zh: 当章节标题是“什么是预拌混凝土”时，混凝土泵分体活塞 φ280仍以哪一句已印文字为准？

answer.en: This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. The source heading does not fill an empty cell.
answer.zh: 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。

question.en: What stays printed for concrete pump split piston φ280 when the section heading is “WHY Use Ready Mixed Concrete”?

answer.en: A service life, a replacement-hour figure and a wear-rate table are not printed. Leave that field blank. The source heading does not fill an empty cell.
answer.zh: 使用寿命、更换小时和磨损速率都没有印出。这一栏留空。

answer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. The source heading does not fill an empty cell.
